about: Review Items, shared by the API's review_items and needs_review (test_enrichment_review.py) and the PWA's reviewItems and reviewOf (review.test.tsx). facts maps each fact the recipe has to whether it is Confirmed; editor_difficulty is whether the editor set the recipe's own Difficulty; open_issues are the fact ids of its open Enrichment Issues; items are the expected Review Items' fact ids by item id; unconfirmed is how many items have a fact not yet Confirmed.
